tagline: The lower-Gulf dive island — the triangle's northern node.
summary: Koh Tao is the lower-Gulf's renowned dive island, the northern node of the Samui<->Phangan<->Tao triangle (~24 nm from Phangan, ~40 nm from Samui). It draws a dedicated global dive-and-leisure segment on long, often-rough ferry crossings — a comfort and reliability gap a premium foiling tier closes on a clean Pioneer II leg.

demand_signals.detail: One of the world's busiest dive-training islands — steady, dedicated inbound flow.
Samui/Phangan crossings are long and frequently rough — comfort caps repeat ridership.
Northern terminus of the lower-Gulf island triangle.

journeys.note: Direct dive transfer, in Pioneer II range.

navier_fit: High as the northern triangle node; clean Pioneer II legs serving a dedicated dive-and-leisure segment; corridors already bound.
competitive_landscape: Long, crowded diesel ferries and speedboats — rough rides, monsoon cancellations, no premium tier.
seasonality: Peak: Dec-Apr; SW monsoon brings rougher, longer crossings. Foiling extends comfort and reliability.
regulatory_note: Thai Marine Department licensing; Surat Thani provincial coordination at established piers.

precedents.label: Lower-Gulf dive market
precedents.note: Dedicated inbound dive flow the foiling tier upgrades on comfort.

grab.super_app_fit: In-app dive-trip and island-triangle bundles from Samui and Phangan.
grab.wedge: The northern dive node of the Samui triangle — premium, smooth, weather-resilient.

transit_planning.note: Lower-Gulf triangle connected city to Koh Samui flagship (corridors sealed). Brief deepened in depth pass.
